item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Witch
  • 発売日: 2005-04-28
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Milkyway3
  • 英語名: Milkyway 3

あらすじ

Over 20 years have passes since events of Milkyway 2. Cafe owners migrated overseas leaving the establishment for Sakuya to inherit. Once again he returns to the cafe in attempt to try to revitalize it with new workers and fight debt. Young entertainment genius Koibun buys crumbling Milkyway from Sakuya. Both descendants of former heroines and new girls flood the coffee shop once more.

item.title: Katayoku no Tenshi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Witch
  • 発売日: 2003-12-19
  • スコア: 6.08/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 片翼の天使
  • 英語名: Katayoku no Tenshi

あらすじ

Title means “One-winged Angel”

The hero, Kazuya Takase, is a third-year at his local school. He’s doing so well that he’s getting job offers, but he’s refusing them all, because he wishes to follow his dream of becoming an actor.

His little sister Mai thinks his dream is unrealistic.

Even by November, with graduation approaching, Kazuya has not found an answer. Should he believe in himself, or should he rethink and follow the stable path laid out for him like his little sister wishes him to?

item.title: Teriru no Christmas BOX
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Witch
  • 発売日: 2002-12-26
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: てりるのクリスマスBOX
  • 英語名: Teriru no Christmas BOX

あらすじ

A fan disc featuring familiar characters from Milkyway in cute uniforms going all out in typing and block-breaking games. As with Ichigo-Da!, the typing games with improved effects and the item-packed block-breaking games guarantee tons of fun! An original story exclusive to the fan disc is included as well, of course.

Other content, such as minigames and wallpapers, are bound to make fans happy.
